name: channel_a_reordered_packet_from_the_owner_is_dropped
description: Latest-wins with hold: a CHAN older than the newest seen from the current owner is dropped. Without it a reordered packet on a lossy network makes the lights jump backwards for one frame, which reads as a glitch rather than as the network. The counter is compared as a wrapping u16 — at 60 Hz it wraps every eighteen minutes, and a plain comparison would stall the channel there until the producer restarted.

steps.description: a packet from before the last one is dropped
so the value is still the newest one that arrived, not the stale one
and a packet from anyone but the owner is dropped whatever its sequence
